title: In vitro release, extraction, and analysis of PCBs and metabolites from polymeric implants
author: Amanda J. Bullert
materials: Cap the vials (Vial_A) and shake vigorously
Analyze 2 mL of all sample extracts

steps.title: Prepare release vials
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of 10 % bovine serum in PBS containing 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (v/v) to each 20 mL amber screw‑cap vial.

steps.title: Add polymeric implants
steps.instruction: Place a 2 cm piece of polymeric implant (0 %, 1 %, 5 % or 10 % 4‑OH‑PCB 52) into each vial, record the implant weight and note the start time of the release study.

steps.title: Incubate release vials
steps.instruction: Put the vials in a shaking water bath set to 37 °C and 40 rpm.

steps.title: Replace media at time points
steps.instruction: At 1 h, 4 h, 12 h, 24 h and every subsequent 24 h, transfer the spent media to 10 mL glass tubes (with PTFE‑coated caps), add 10 mL fresh media to the vial, record the exact time of the exchange, and store the old media tubes at 4 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Prepare calibration curve
steps.instruction: Make a seven‑point matrix‑matched calibration curve by spiking known amounts of 4‑OH‑PCB 52 into fresh medium, then subject the standards to the same extraction procedure as the samples; run the calibration before, during and after the sample batch.

steps.title: Transfer media samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 3 mL of each collected media sample into clean, well‑labeled glass vials (Vial_A).

steps.title: Acidify samples
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 2 M HCl to each Vial_A and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Add extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of hexane:MTBE (9:1, v/v) to each Vial_A.

steps.title: Break emulsion if needed
steps.instruction: If an emulsion forms, add 0.5 g NaCl to the vial; otherwise skip this step.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Invert the vials for 5 min, then centrifuge at 1811 g (3000 rpm) for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect organic layer
steps.instruction: Transfer the top (organic) layer to a new clean glass vial (Vial_B).

steps.title: Store extracts
steps.instruction: Cap Vial_B and store at –20 °C until UV/Vis analysis.

steps.title: Transfer extract to cuvette
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 mL of each organic extract (or calibration standard) into a clean quartz cuvette.

steps.title: Zero spectrophotometer
steps.instruction: Use 2 mL of hexane:MTBE (9:1, v/v) as the first blank to zero the UV/Vis instrument.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Record absorbance at 285 nm, keeping the cuvette and instrument at 25 °C (use a circulating water bath if available); dilute the sample if absorbance exceeds 1.0.

steps.title: Rinse cuvette between samples
steps.instruction: Thoroughly rinse the cuvette after each measurement and reuse the same cuvette for all samples to minimize wall‑related refraction differences.

steps.title: Repeat measurements in triplicate
steps.instruction: Perform steps 13‑16 two additional times for each extract, yielding three absorbance readings per sample.

steps.title: Re‑analyze calibration standards
steps.instruction: After all sample measurements, analyze 2 mL of each calibration standard a second time to verify instrument stability.

steps.title: Generate calibration curve
steps.instruction: Plot absorbance versus known concentration for the calibration standards; use the resulting equation (e.g., concentration = (Abs‑0.0023)/0.0085) for quantification.

steps.title: Calculate sample concentrations
steps.instruction: Apply the calibration equation to the absorbance values of the sample extracts to determine 4‑OH‑PCB 52 concentrations in the hexane:MTBE extracts.
